party.fork: The trail forks here. Each path has its own three Stops.
family.gate_sort.blurb: Each gate lets some Pathkins in. Find out who goes where.
family.gate_trio.blurb: Gate one picks first, gate two picks next, gate three takes the rest.
family.bridge_pair.blurb: Each bridge holds one kind of Pathkin. Which kind?
family.pattern_grid.blurb: Every Pathkin has one right patch. Rows and columns each follow a rule.
family.tour_path.blurb: The trail forks twice. Each fork lets some Pathkins left and some right.

coach.learn: Look at who got in and who bounced. What do they share?
summary.stranded: {n} got stranded. Look for them at {camp}.
camp.homeNote: These Pathkins are home for good.
camp.strandedNote: Stranded Pathkins wait nearby. Tap one to bring it in.

rescue.noFriends: Nobody is at this camp to send yet.
toast.stranded: {n} stranded. Find them at the next camp.
toast.rescueMiss: Only {n} traits in common. A friend needs {need}.
assist.freeHint: That was a hard one. Here is a free hint token.
assist.tierUp: You are flying through this leg. Try {tier}?
inspect.guide: A trail guide. It shows where its kind belongs.
goals.title: Goals
goals.body: Little milestones. There is no rush and nothing to lose.
goal.flawless: Clear a Stop with no wrong tries
goal.five_flawless: Clear five Stops with no wrong tries
goal.first_leg: Lead a party to the next camp
goal.full_party: Bring a full party of 16 through a leg
goal.both_forks: Walk every path of the Trail
goal.no_hints_leg: Clear a leg without a hint

family.room_grid.blurb: Every Pathkin has one right room. One trait picks the floor, another picks the door.
family.rank_line.blurb: The line has an order, front to back. Find which trait sets it.
family.totem_match.blurb: Each post has a glyph. Each glyph stands for one kind of Pathkin.
family.toss_plot.blurb: Each Pathkin lands on one patch. One trait picks the row, another the column.
family.bench_link.blurb: Seat everyone. Neighbours joined by a bar must share a trait. Tap a seat to lift someone.
family.link_web.blurb: Seat everyone. Each rope letter stands for one trait that both ends must share.
family.trade_ledger.blurb: Each keeper wants its own foods, all of them and nothing else. Fill the offer, then tap a keeper.
family.signal_guess.blurb: The stone calls for one Pathkin. Send who you think it is and read the marks.
family.echo_match.blurb: The pond changes what it shows. Find who casts this reflection.
family.switch_run.blurb: Each shed takes one coat. Set the switches, pick a convoy, and send. Some riders flip a switch as they pass.
stop.seatMiss: It does not get on with a neighbour
stop.tradeBad: The keeper does not want some of that
stop.signalMiss: Not that one. Read the marks.
stop.pondMiss: That one casts a different reflection
hint.switch: The trigger of switch {n} is now showing
